source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text: The prepared sucker or corm piece is set into its planting hole so that the base sits at a similar depth to how it grew on the mother plant, then backfilled with the topsoil-compost mix and watered in immediately. Farmers are advised to plant during a period of reliable moisture (such as the start of the rainy season) where possible, to reduce the need for supplemental watering while the young plant establishes its root system.
